verses.1: A Song of Ascents. When the LORD brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
verses.2: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said amongst the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
verses.3: The LORD has done great things for us, and we are glad.
verses.4: Restore our fortunes again, LORD, like the streams in the Negev.
verses.5: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
verses.6: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
